02-bismer.text:
Two weighings are sworn. Name the light pouch.
Every pouch is sworn to the same weight: 27 ertog — one mark is eight øre, one øre three ertog. One pouch was clipped, and runs light. The pan that sinks holds the heavier silver.
First weighing — the beam hangs level
Second weighing — the right pan sinks
Reckon the labels in ertog
Skip the showing
Lift a pouch from the rack to name it. By key: arrows walk the rack, space names one, X strikes one out.
2 øre 21 ertog
1 mark 3 ertog
1 mark 1 øre
1 øre 24 ertog
6 øre 9 ertog
1 mark 1 øre
Name the pouch
Watch once: a pouch is lifted from the rack, and set back.
aria: The First weighing: left pan þurs, óss; right pan fé, kaun; set aside úr, reið; the beam hangs level.
The Second weighing: left pan reið, kaun; right pan úr, óss; set aside fé, þurs; the right pan sinks.
The carved reckoning rule: one mark is eight øre, one øre three ertog, so one mark is twenty-four ertog.
The six pouches on the merchant’s rack
Pouch under the fé seal, sworn 2 øre 21 ertog
Pouch under the úr seal, sworn 1 mark 3 ertog
Pouch under the þurs seal, sworn 1 mark 1 øre
Pouch under the óss seal, sworn 1 øre 24 ertog
Pouch under the reið seal, sworn 6 øre 9 ertog
Pouch under the kaun seal, sworn 1 mark 1 øre

03-beacons.text:
Turn the dial to the next night all three fires burn together.
Tonight is night nought; the dial runs to night 24. Drag the wheel, or use the arrow keys.
Set the dial
Skip the showing
Night 2 — Vindstad is dark, Nordfell is dark, Grimsholm is dark.
aria: The beacon coast. Vindstad, every 4 nights, burned 1 night ago; Nordfell, every 3 nights, burned 2 nights ago; Grimsholm, every 5 nights, burned 1 night ago
The night dial

Ketil swears: the burnt plank laps the pale plank. 28 over 14

1 of eight joints lie fair
Lap law: a strake laps the one below it and no other. Seven planks, one stack. Rivet law: where two strakes lap, one rivet count is odd and the other even. One testimony is false.
Drag a plank to move it, or lift it with space and move it with the up and down arrows. Tap a tally-board to brand that oath false.
Raise the stack
Skip the showing
Watch once: a plank is lifted and set one place higher.
aria: The building cradle: the stack, sheer strake at the top, keel at the foot
the burnt plank, 28 rivets, seventh strake from the keel
the scarfed plank, 27 rivets, sixth strake from the keel
the resined plank, 15 rivets, fifth strake from the keel

the green plank, 18 rivets, third strake from the keel
the salt-white plank, 22 rivets, second strake from the keel
the tarred plank, 17 rivets, first strake from the keel, its lap lies fair
The seven testimonies, hung on the rail — brand the false one

05-knotwork.text:
Turn the free crossings until one unbroken band runs the whole panel, over-under all the way.
Follow the band
Bind the knot
Skip the showing
Watch once: one crossing turns, and the gleam runs further along the band.
The weave reads as 6 bands.
One band runs the whole panel and returns to itself. Following it, every crossing goes over, then under, then over — never twice the same. Tap a crossing to lay it the other way. By key: arrows to walk the panel, space to lay a crossing, T to follow the band.
aria: The knot panel, four rows of four
row 1, stave 1: a crossing, the standing band lies over.
row 1, stave 2: a crossing, the running band lies over.
row 1, stave 3: a crossing, the standing band lies over.
